title: Coral and the Orbit
author: Bram Okafor
blurb: Yara Nystrom, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
